body.statement: If each cell survivor mass is positive and every endpoint has a unique separated projection, minimum, and cut branch, then \(\mathrm{CI}_n\) is first-order equivalent to the ordinary joint Gaussian delta-method interval based on the two active quotient gradients.
body.justification: This is the required regular-case reduction and guards against paying for nonexistent ties.
body.gap: It recovers the familiar smooth endpoint limit as a corollary rather than imposing smoothness on the main class.
body.consumer: It lets standard software and influence-function calculations validate the new implementation on well-separated empirical designs.
